Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000185": The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so the notifier is down whenever the bus is down.  (about: the bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000171" [decision]: Notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000169": The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a notifier consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000167": The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01 during INC-2025-004.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000063": The Boreal team owns the notifier.  (about: Boreal team, notifier)
- memory_id "1000205" [decision]: Marcus takes over the pager rotation for the Boreal team from Lena on 2025-02-12.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000069": The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000190": The webhook dispatcher relies on the bus for outbound events, so the webhook dispatcher is down whenever the bus is down.  (about: the bus, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000057": The Boreal team looks after the bus.  (about: Boreal team, the bus)
- memory_id "1000011": The Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000092": The Ember team is currently a one-person team consisting of Oskar.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000103" [decision]: Oskar takes the first on-call shift of the year for the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000145": The reporting service depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export.  (about: ledger service, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000134": The job scheduler is owned by the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000212" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the authentication gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000177" [decision]: The Ember team does pairing on every production change.  (about: Ember team)
- memory_id "1000161" [constraint]: The ledger service must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.  (about: ledger service, Postgres 14)
- memory_id "1000174" [constraint]: Deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000039": The billing API is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, billing API)
- memory_id "1000107" [constraint]: The ledger service only ships on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
